productSpec.title: Academia Ia Core Web Experience
productSpec.problem_statement: Open-access static educational platform for Academia Ia (Surface Mode: Read, strict CSP + Trusted Types).

user_experience.primary_flow: Learner navigates MPA curriculum -> reads 65ch lesson, explores Pagefind index, and practices in isolated 1:1 MessageChannel sandbox with local browser progress.
error_states: Offline navigation served from lightweight MPA Service Worker cache (< 250 KB precache)
Invalid user input rejected by Valibot schema validation
Sandboxed tutor MessageChannel schema mismatch rejected fail-closed
user_experience.visual_theme: OKLCH 90/8/2 Editorial Read Mode (65ch) + 3 Semantic Level Accents + WCAG 2.2 AA+

acceptance_criteria: Zero UI layout thrashing or horizontal overflow across 1440px, 768px, and 390px viewports.
100% WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance (semantic landmarks <main>, <nav>, ARIA labels, APCA contrast).
Zero inline executable <script> blocks or inline onclick handlers (strict CSP compliance).
100% static Read-mode architecture (0 backend Worker API endpoints, Trusted Types enforced, 1:1 MessageChannel tutor sandbox).

techSpec.title: Academia Ia Core Web Experience — Architecture & Technical Spec
techSpec.architecture_tier: Astro 7.4.11 Static + Cloudflare Workers Static Assets ($0.00 USD Server)
security_invariants: Trusted Types enforced: default.createHTML throws TypeError; dynamic HTML sanitized via DOMPurify (RETURN_TRUSTED_TYPE: true) or safe DOM APIs.
Zero eval() or new Function() calls; strict CSP generated deterministically from src/lib/csp-builder.mjs.
Sandboxed tutor communicates over dedicated 1:1 MessageChannel validated with Valibot (0 backend endpoints).
